verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: UA fetalai mai foi Ieova ia MoseOg ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
verses.sm: Fai atu ia i le« fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia i latou, O tausamiga ia ieova tou te tala‘i ai, o faapotopotoga paia, o tausamiga lava ia ia te au.

verses.en: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.sm: E ono aso e fai ai galuega; a o le aso fitu, o le sapati lea e malolo ai, e fai ai le faapotopotoga paia, aua tou te fai ai se galuega e tasi; o le sapati lea ia Ieova i mea uma tou te nonofo ai.

verses.en: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.sm: O tausamiga ia ia Ieova, o faapotopotoga paia, ia outou tala‘i ai i o latou aso ua atofaina.

verses.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD'S passover.
verses.sm: O le masina muamua, o le aso e tasi le sefulu ma le fa o le masina, o le afiafi, o le paseka lea ia Ieova.

verses.en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.sm: O le aso e tasi le sefulu ma le lima o lea lava masina, o le tausamiga lea ia Ieova o le areto e le faafefeteina; o aso lava e fitu tou te aai ai le areto e le faafefeteina.

verses.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.sm: O le aso muamua tou te fai ai se faapotopotoga paia, aua tou te fai ai se galuega mamafa.

verses.en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.sm: A ia outou avatua taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova i aso e fitu; o le aso fitu o le faapotopotoga paia lea; aua lava tou te fai ai se galuega mamafa.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.sm: Fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia i latou, A outou oo i le nuu ou te avatua mo outou, ma outou fai ai le seleselegāsaito, ona outou au mai ai lea o le fusi saito o mea ua faapolopoloina o lo outou seleselega i le faitaulaga.

verses.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.sm: E luluina foi e ia o le fusi sāito i luma o ieova, ina ia talia mo outou; o le aso e aupito mai i le sapati e luluina ai e le faitaulaga.

verses.en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.sm: O le aso foi tou te luluina ai le fusi saito, tou te avatua ai se mamoe poa e sao ona lelei, e tasi lona tausaga, e fai ma taulaga mu ia ieova.

verses.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
verses.sm: O le taulaga foi i mea e ‘ai e tatau i ai, e lua omera o le falaoa lelei ua palua ma le uu, o le taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova, o le mea manogi lelei; ma le taulaga i le mea e inu e tatau i ai, o lona vaega e fa o le sinu o uaina.

verses.en: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.sm: Aua tou te aai foi sina areto, po o se saito tunua, po o saito mata seia oo i lea lava aso ua au mai ai se taulaga i lo outou Atua; o le tulafono lea e faavavau i o outou tupulaga amuli i mea uma tou te nonofo ai.

verses.en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.sm: Ia outou faitaulia e amata i le aso e aupito mai i le sapati, o le aso lava na outou au mai ai le fusi saito o le taulaga lulu; ia atoatoa o sapati e fitu.

verses.en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.sm: E oo lava i le aso e aupito mai i le sapati e fitu tou te faitau ai o aso e limagafulu; ona fai taulaga ai lea i le taulaga i mea e ‘ai fou ia Ieova.

verses.en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Tou te au mai nai o outou fale o areto lulu e lua fua, e tailua omera, e fai i le falaoa lelei, ia tao ma le mea e faafefete a‘i, o mea faapolopolo ia ia Ieova.

verses.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ia outou avatua faatasi ma areto o tamai mamoe e fitu, e tasi lo latou tausaga e sao ona lelei, atoa ma le tamai povi poa e tasi, ma mamoe poa e lua, e fai ia ma taulaga mu ia ieova, atoa ma taulaga i mea e ‘ai e tatau i ai, ma taulaga i le mea e inu e tatau i ai, o le taulaga lava e fai i le afi, o le mea manogi lelei ia Ieova.

verses.en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.sm: Ona fai taulaga ai lea outou i se ‘oti poa e tasi e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala, atoa ma tamai mamoe e lua e tasi lo la tausaga, e fai ma taulaga faafetai.

verses.en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.sm: Ona luluina ai lea o ia mea e le faitaulaga atoa ma le areto o mea faapolopoloina, e fai ma taulaga lulu i luma o Ieova, atoa ma tamai mamoe e lua; e paia ia mea ia Ieova mā le faitaulaga.

verses.en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.sm: Ia outou tala‘i i lea lava aso e fai ai se faapotopotoga paia e outou; tou te le fai ai se galuega mamafa e tasi; o le tulafono lea e faavavau i mea uma tou te nonofo ai i o outou tupulaga amuli.

verses.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: A outou selesele foi le seleselegāsaito i o outou fanua, aua le faauma ou pito fanua pe a e selesele i ai; aua foi e te ao ni fua ua pauu i lau seleselega, a ia tuu mo e matitiva ma le tagata ese; o a‘u o Ieova lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.sm: Fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu, O le fituga masina, o le aso muamua o le masina ia outou fai ai se sapati, o le faamanatuga i le iligāpu, o le faapotopotoga paia.

verses.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua tou te fai ai se galuega mamafa e tasi, a ia outou avatu se taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova Ua fetalai mai Ieova ia Mose,

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.sm: O le aso sefulu o lea lava fituga masina, o le aso o le togiola lea; o le faapotopotoga paia lea ia te outou; ia puapuagatia ai outou e outou, ma avatu ai se taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova.

w.en: which is the of the atonement—

verses.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Aua tou te faia se galuega e tasi i lea lava aso; auā o le aso lea o le togiola, e fai ai se togiola mo outou i luma o Ieova lo outou Atua.

w.en: in that in the very day;
which is the is the day

verses.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata e le puapuagatia o ia e ia i lea lava aso, e vavaeeseina o ia i lona nuu.

w.en: in that in the very day,

verses.en: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata foi na te faia se galuega e tasi i lea lava aso, e fano ia te au o lea tagata ai lona lava. nuu.

w.en: in that in the very day,

verses.en: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.sm: Aua tou te fai ai se galuega e tasi; o le tulafono lea e faavavau i o outou tupulaga amuli, i mea uma tou te nonofo ai.

verses.en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.sm: E fai lea ma sapati e malolo ai outou, e puapuagatia ai outou e outou; o le afiafi o le aso iva o le masina, e amata mai i le afiafi e oo lava i le tasi afiafi, tou te fai ai ma sapati e malolo ai.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu, O le aso sefulu ma le lima o lea lava fituga masina, o le tausamiga o fale apitaga lea, e faia i aso e fitu ia Ieova.

verses.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.sm: O le aso muamua, o le faapotopotoga paia lea; aua tou te fai ai se galuega mamafa e tasi.

verses.en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.sm: O aso e fitu ia outou avatu ai taulaga 'e fai i le afi ia Ieova; o le aso valu e fai ai le faapotopotoga paia e outou; ia outou avatu ai se taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova; o le faapotopotoga lea; aua tou te fai ai se galuega mamafa e tasi.

verses.en: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.sm: O tausamiga ia ia Ieova tou te tala‘i ai, o faapotopotoga paia, e avatu ai se taulaga e fai i le afi ia Ieova, o le taulaga mu, ma le taulaga i mea e ‘ai, o le taulaga i mea ua fasia, ma le taulaga i mea e inu, o le aso ma ana mea;

verses.en: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.sm: atoa ma sapati o Ieova, atoa foi ma a outou mea foai fua, atoa foi ma mea uma ua outou tauto ai, atoa foi ma taulaga ua outou loto fua ina fai, tou te aumaia ia Ieova.

verses.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
verses.sm: O le aso sefulu ma le lima o le fituga masina, pe a uma ona faaputuina e outou le fua o lc fanua, ia outou faia lava Se tausamiga ia Ieova i aso e fitu; o le aso muamua e fai ma sapati lea, i le ma le aso valu e fai ma sapati foi lea.

verses.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.sm: O le aso muamua foi tou te ave ai fua o laau matagofie, o lau pama, ma la o laau felefele, ma garava mai le alia; ma ia outou olioli i luma o Ieova lo outou Atua i aso e fitu;

verses.en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.sm: ma ia outou fai ai le tausamiga ia Ieova i aso e fitu i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga; o le tulafono e faavavau i o outou tupulaga amuli; ia outou faia le tausamiga i le fituga masina.

verses.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.sm: Tou te nonofo i fale apitaga i aso e fitu, o tama a le eleele uma i Isaraelu latou te nonofo i fale apitaga;

verses.en: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: ina ia iloa e o outou tupulaga amuli na ou faanofo ai le fanauga a Isaraelu i fale apitaga, ina ua ou au mai ia i latou ai le nuu o Aikupito; o a4u o ieova lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona ta‘u atu lea e Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu o tausamiga ia Ieova. O le suāuu olive e mu ai pea le
